# .github/workflows/

## Purpose

CI/CD pipeline definitions. `unified-ci.yml` is the main pipeline (validate → test → security → status jobs); `release.yml` is manual-dispatch-only (see root `AGENTS.md`); others handle Dependabot automation, security scanning, docs, and evaluations.

## Ownership

- `unified-ci.yml` — thin caller: `validate` (→ `reusable-python-lint.yml`), `test` (→ `reusable-python-test.yml`, both `tests/` and `simplenote_mcp/tests/` preserved as separate pytest processes), `security` (→ `reusable-security-scan.yml`, shared with `monitoring-consolidated.yml`), `build_and_publish` (→ `reusable-docker-build.yml`), `local-test` (→ `reusable-local-test.yml`), `status` (aggregation, stays inline — needs `needs.*.result` from sibling jobs in the same file). Blocks on version consistency before test/build/security run. **`test`/`security` job IDs are load-bearing**: their displayed check names (`test / Test`, `security / Security`) are live required branch-protection status checks (`validate / Validate` is not required, despite existing) — do not rename these job IDs, or the internal `name:` field of the reusable workflows they call, without first reading the actual resulting check name off a live PR and updating branch protection in the same window (see the 2026-08-13 Phase 9 refactor for the verification protocol).
- `security.yml`, `dependency-review.yml` — Bandit/pip-audit/CodeQL-style scanning.
- `auto-fix.yml` — thin caller: `resolve-target` job (inline branch/fix-type allowlist validation, no checkout needed) → `reusable-auto-fix-apply.yml` (checkout target branch, ruff fix/commit/push — kept inline rather than script-extracted, since the target branch may predate this refactor and lack `scripts/`) → `reusable-auto-fix-notify.yml` (PR comment via `.github/scripts/find-associated-pr.js`/`comment-auto-fix.js`, summary). `auto-merge.yml` — thin caller: `auto-merge` (→ `reusable-auto-merge-pr.yml`) + `dependabot-auto-merge` (→ `reusable-dependabot-auto-merge.yml`, gated on `github.actor`/`github.event_name` at the *caller* job level, not inside the reusable workflow, since `github.event_name` inside a called `workflow_call` job is not reliably the original triggering event). Neither reusable workflow adds a checkout step — both are triggered by fork-reachable PR events with write-level permissions, so checking out PR content and `require()`-ing a script from it would be a "pwn request" vector; their `github-script` bodies stay inline instead. `claude-dependabot-merge.yml`, `claude-status-check.yml` — Dependabot/PR automation (external-repo thin callers).
- `evaluation-quality-gate.yml` — thin caller: `reusable-eval-quality-run.yml` (npm eval suite, gated on `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` presence so Dependabot PRs skip gracefully; parsing via `scripts/ci/parse_eval_results.py`) → `reusable-eval-quality-report.yml` (PR comment + check-run via `.github/scripts/post-quality-gate-comment.js`/`create-quality-gate-check.js`). `mcp-evaluations.yml` — thin caller: `reusable-mcp-eval-run.yml` (3 `mclenhard/mcp-evals` invocations against `evals/*.yaml`, gated on `OPENAI_API_KEY` presence — a *different* secret than `evaluation-quality-gate.yml`'s `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`, previously misdocumented here as the same; falls back to `scripts/ci/manual_smoke_test.py` when absent) → `reusable-mcp-eval-pr-check.yml` (`scripts/ci/validate_eval_yaml.py`, PR comment via `.github/scripts/comment-eval-files-changed.js`).
- `release.yml` — manual `workflow_dispatch` version bump/release (patch/minor/major); thin caller: `reusable-release-prepare.yml` (version bump via `scripts/release/bump_version.sh`, changelog via `scripts/release/generate_release_changelog.sh`, commit/tag/push/GitHub-Release — single job, see in-file overage note) → `reusable-release-build.yml` (build/twine, SBOM+vuln reports via `scripts/generate_release_security_reports.py`, kept version-synced with the tool pins this script installs) → `reusable-release-attach-reports.yml`; `notify` job stays inline in the caller. `update-version.yml` — thin caller (`reusable-version-sync.yml`); triggers on `v*.*.*` tag push (also accepts `workflow_dispatch` with a manual `tag` input, for testing), syncs version references post-release via `scripts/release/sync_version_references.sh`.
- `docs.yml` — thin caller (docs build via `reusable-docs-build.yml`, Pages deploy via `reusable-docs-deploy.yml`, link check via `reusable-docs-link-check.yml`). `monitoring-consolidated.yml` — thin caller (`reusable-security-scan.yml` — parametrized for eventual reuse by `unified-ci.yml`'s `security` job — `reusable-health-check.yml`, `reusable-badge-check.yml` — adopts `scripts/validate-badges.py` — `reusable-monitoring-summary.yml`). `publish-pypi.yml` — PyPI publish.
- `reusable-*.yml` — local `workflow_call` reusable workflows, each owned by and used only by the caller(s) listed against it above. Not standalone triggers; see the owning caller for `on:` semantics. Introduced 2026-08-12 as part of a phased thin-caller refactor (org-standard ≤80-line-per-file check) — the docdyhr org's usual pattern delegates to the separate `docdyhr/.github` repo (see `security.yml`/`claude-status-check.yml`/`claude-dependabot-merge.yml` below), but these use local composition instead by deliberate choice (no cross-repo versioning/tagging overhead for logic specific to this repo).

## Local Contracts

- **`yaml.safe_load()` is not sufficient to validate `uses:` lines.** A YAML-valid-but-schema-invalid `uses:` value (e.g. a bare SHA with the tag comment misplaced, instead of `owner/repo@<sha> # tag`) parses cleanly but makes GitHub run **zero jobs** for every workflow referencing it. Only a schema-aware linter (`actionlint`) catches this class of bug — not currently run in CI. Run `actionlint` on any `.github/workflows/*.yml` edit before considering it done, especially SHA-pinning changes.
- **`github-script` steps must pass untrusted values via `env:`**, never interpolate `${{ needs.*.outputs.* }}` / `${{ github.event.inputs.* }}` / `${{ steps.*.outputs.* }}` directly into the `script:` body — an injected value could break out of the JS string literal (script-injection). Read via `process.env.*` instead; see the existing pattern and comment in `auto-fix.yml`.
- `dependabot.yml` (one directory up, at `.github/dependabot.yml`) covers four ecosystems: `pip`, `npm`, `docker`, `github-actions` — keep all four current when adding a new dependency manager to the project.
- **`auto-merge.yml`'s `dependabot-auto-merge` job auto-approves and merges patch/minor Dependabot PRs, but skips any PR touching a security-sensitive package** (`cryptography`, `requests`, `urllib3`, `aiohttp` — matched via `contains()` against `dependency-names`, so those PRs always fall through to manual review regardless of update type). Add to that list when a new security-sensitive dependency is introduced.
- `main` branch protection requires 3 status checks (configured 2026-08-11, contexts updated 2026-08-13 after the thin-caller refactor changed their displayed names): `test / Test`, `security / Security`, `Dependency Review`. `Validate` was never in the required list, so its post-refactor name (`validate / Validate`) isn't either. **Renaming `unified-ci.yml`'s `test`/`security` job IDs, or the internal `name:` field of `reusable-python-test.yml`/`reusable-security-scan.yml`, changes these check names again** — update branch protection (`gh api repos/docdyhr/simplenote-mcp-server/branches/main/protection --method PUT`, see git history around 2026-08-13 for the exact JSON body shape) in the same window as any such rename, or every subsequent PR becomes permanently unmergeable.

## Verification

- `actionlint` on any changed workflow file (manual — not yet wired into CI itself)
- Push/PR and watch the `validate` job in `unified-ci.yml` actually queues and runs
